The Bible calls us to care for all creatures (e.g., Matthew 10:29-31, Luke 12:6-7). 2. **Mercy vs. Arbitrary Intervention (Matthew 9:13, Luke 6:36)** - While compassion for suffering animals is commendable, injecting a tranquilizer without consent or necessity could be seen as unnecessary interference.
